name: openai-cpa
description: Enterprise Distributed Automation Platform for massive concurrent workload execution. Unifies elastic cluster orchestration, multi-channel identity verification messaging, real-time ops telemetry, and multi-warehouse lifecycle control (CPA / Sub2API / Image2API) in one high-throughput control plane.

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: It serves as a centralized Web Orchestration Hub that seamlessly synchronizes distributed browser extension workers (Classic Mode), multi-backend mailbox engines, and enterprise-grade cloud warehouses (CPA/Sub2API) into…
capability_evidence.notifications: / stop and automatically identifies normal, CPA, or Sub2API mode.

friction.note_en: Some setup. install via pip install; needs docker compose up, pip install -r requirements; configure config.json/yaml/toml, OAuth login flow; one-click setup
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。可通过 pip install 安装；需要 docker compose up、pip install -r requirements；需配置 config.json/yaml/toml、OAuth login flow；one-click setup

analysis.summary_en: An advanced Distributed Automation Platform for high-concurrency account registration and full-lifecycle inventory management.
highlights: Docker-aware proxy adaptation: Rewrites 127.0.0.1 / localhost to host.docker.internal inside containers when needed.
Multi-threaded Clash proxy-pool mode: Multi-container / multi-port pool via clashproxypool.poolmode + warpproxy_list.
